progress.command:
git "commit" "-m" "fix: stop a pi-action run that the agent starts inside a run

In run 43520110827 the agent ran node src/index.ts from pit's shell. The
child inherited the step's environment and ran the action again on the
same thread: it moved refs/pi-action/threads/66 under the outer run, whose
storage was then poisoned, and the run failed.

pi-action now sets PI_ACTION_RUNNING (its process ID) in its own
environment at startup, which every tool and child process inherits.
src/index.ts fails at once when it is set, before it reads inputs or
touches a ref; src/push.ts pushes nothing."
